description: This file contains the implementation of the AzureAppendBlobLogStorage class, which manages append blob storage operations in Azure Blob Storage for journaling purposes within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for appending, deleting, reading, and replacing log data, as well as handling snapshots and logging activities.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobLogStorage
classes.description: A class that manages append blob storage operations in Azure Blob Storage, including appending, reading, replacing, and deleting log data, with support for snapshots and logging.

methods.name: AppendAsync
methods.description: Appends log data to the Azure append blob, creating the blob if it does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes the append blob from Azure storage.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Reads log data from the append blob, yielding log extents.

methods.name: CopyFromSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Copies a snapshot of the blob and restores it if necessary.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Replaces the blob content with a new snapshot, overwriting existing data.
